items.title: John Levy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Kelly’s Stable? That’s a local spot.

ctx.x: Yeah, that’s right. Different work with Lucky. But that was back on 52nd Street. That was probably right after leaving the trio.
Kelly’s Stable? That’s a local spot.
Don Byas. I did a thing with Don. I worked with Don Byas for a while.
